The '''Arblis Forest''' was a vast, dense [[Forest/Legends|forest]] dominating the main continent of the [[planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. To the west were some colonized plains, and the [[Ragnook Mountains]].<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref>

While Kothlis had been colonized several years before the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the forest had remained unexplored and undeveloped by the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], teeming with exotic animals and plants. [[Rathleek]], the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] [[Spearmaster]], hunted game in the forest along with his clan members, and often were hired as guides or for hunting expeditions for elite [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]].<ref name="guide" />

The dark, majestic forest composed mostly of [[Gankto tree]]s and was home to several creatures, including [[Myntor]]s, the burrowing reptilian predators, and [[ganjuko]]s (imported from [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]]).<ref name="guide" />
